verdict.rationale: Sentry's official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (openapi-derefed.json) for the Sentry Public API, and the API docs describe the versioned (v0) public API it covers. The probe's 404s on conventional docs.sentry.io paths show only that the spec lives elsewhere, not that it is missing, so there is no dispute. missing for 10: discoverability at standard well-known/docs paths (probe found none), first-party docs page explicitly linking to the spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes the machine-readable spec openapi-derefed.json: {"openapi": "3.0.3", "info": {"title": "API Reference", "version": "v0", "description": "Sentry Public API"}}.
The current version of the Sentry's web API is considered v0. Our public endpoints are generally stable, but beta endpoints are subject to change.
